mig.summary:
# Migration proposal from the old Todo Manager

Snapshot: {fetched_at} (read-only queries; the old pages and data were not modified).
{tasks} old tasks, {projects} old projects.

| Category | Count | Default action |
|---|---|---|
| Still open (to do / in progress / waiting) | {active} | keep: imported as new tasks (old notes kept as background) |
| Inbox items marked P1, high confidence or with a future due date | {inbox_candidate} | review: change each to keep or drop |
| Closed by you (done / abandoned) | {closed_by_user} | history: imported as closed records, never shown in Notion, so old reminders cannot revive them |
| Closed by the old automation | {closed_by_system} | drop |
| Other inbox items (unreviewed old noise) | {inbox_noise} | drop: stay on the old page, not imported |
| In the old trash | {trashed} | drop |

Totals: {actions}; projects kept: {projects_kept} (those referenced by keep/review tasks).

How to change it: edit the `action` column (keep / history / drop) of `tasks.csv` / `projects.csv` in this folder;
`review` must be resolved before importing. Then run `todo-manager migrate apply <this folder>` (without --yes for a preview).
Importing writes only the local database; the new Notion pages appear on the next sync, and only keep tasks are shown.
